metadata.description: Two self-hosted servers for agents, each one MCP endpoint: browser-box (hosted browsers you drive: Browser Use Cloud, Browserbase as backup, no subscription to start) and data-box (web data with a cost cap on every call). Run them on your own machine or server with your own keys.

plugins.name: browser-box
plugins.description: Read, click through and screenshot web pages through your own browser-box, on hosted browsers (Browser Use Cloud; Browserbase as the emergency backup): fetch and status free; read and session with a pay-as-you-go Browser Use key; act, task and computer when you add their keys.

plugins.name: data-box
plugins.description: Web data and lead lists through your own data-box, plan first: a free scrape of any public URL, or a surveyed, priced plan that runs only on approval. One skill per data tool; each switches on when you add its key.
